definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is true to a greater degree than usual.

definitions.gloss: ironically, as luck would have it
definitions.explanation: Introduces an ironic or unexpected situation (often as 〜なことに).

examples.japanese: ⟦{皮肉|ひにく}→皮肉：00103_hiniku⟧なことに、⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
ことに⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧なことに、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧なことに、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{怪我|けが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しなかった→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
ことに has two distinct uses as an adverb.

USE 1: ESPECIALLY
- Emphasizes degree
- Similar to ⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧, {殊|こと}に
- ことに〜だ/ことに〜が〜

USE 2: 〜なことに (IRONICALLY/FORTUNATELY)
- Introduces situation with emotional evaluation
- Always follows na-adjective or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{皮肉|ひにく}→皮肉：00103_hiniku⟧なことに (ironically)
- ⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧なことに (unfortunately)
- ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧なことに (fortunately)
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ことに (surprisingly)
- ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧ことに (unfortunately, problematically)

NOTE: When written as {殊|こと}に, it typically means "especially" (sense 1).
